name: Royal Rajasthan Heritage Tour
shortDescription: Palaces, forts, and royal cuisine across Jaipur and Udaipur.
description: A 6-day journey through Rajasthan's most iconic palaces and forts, with guided heritage walks, a sunset boat ride on Lake Pichola, and a traditional Rajasthani thali dinner in a restored haveli.

itinerary.title: Departure
